The '''D-Type Stealth Freighter''' was designed by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]] following the Nubian tradition of designing unusual vessels. Most craft intended for smuggling depended on speed or firepower to avoid capture. The D-type instead relied almost entirely on stealth, carrying no weapons and only managing a low sublight speed due to the baffle shielding drive it was equipped with. Unlike most light freighters, the D-Type was not designed to allow modification of any kind. Instead, if an owner wishes a modified version of the ship, they must commission a customized one from the manufacturer.
